text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Look! This is Gran Alegria's run!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Miiileeeer!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, I can feel Gran-chan's overwhelming 
presence...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (I won't lose... Not even me!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: *Haaah*, *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~! No way... Consecutive losses in 
the mile, for me...?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...I really can't overlook this. I need 
to rethink both my running and my personal 
rules from scratch."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah... *cough*, *wheeze*!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan, are you okay!? You're 
wobbling! I'll go get a sports drink right 
now!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm, s-sorry... *pant, pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis was utterly exhausted. She 
appeared mentally drained as well.
choice_data_list: You really overdid it, didn't you?
You really overdid it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... I just got so absorbed in 
it...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't even remember how I 
ran...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, it was a frantic, reckless run—quite 
unlike her usual self.
choice_data_list: How did it come to this...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Facing Gran-chan in the paddock, I was 
completely overwhelmed by her presence...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: âI figured it out instantly.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan's Genesis Factor is far 
exceeding my predictions...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Her Genesis Factor is an extraordinary 
talent— and the pride and confidence born 
from it.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan possessed a genius so profound 
it felt like a "historical 
inevitability"...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
History... chooses Gran-chan's victory. 
How could anyone resist that...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I simply ran while feeling confused, 
driven solely by the desire not to lose...
choice_data_list: I see... Well, at least you weren't hurt.
I see... Still, I'm glad you weren't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To stay calm... I know it in theory, but 
still.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Controlling one's emotions is quite 
difficult, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Chrono Genesis was shaken by the 
win probability calculated by the Genesis 
Method.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of my knowledge of various 
historical facts, I unconsciously mapped 
it onto similar cases and felt that 'Gran 
Alegria will win.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Historical records and methodical data are 
merely information. I must take care not 
to become overly bound by them.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I shall devote myself to 
improvement!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And soon after, the training for the Oaks 
will begin.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's wrap it up with that

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... I'm sorry, that run didn't 
satisfy me at all... Please, give me three 
more reps!
choice_data_list:
Overworking yourself too much isn't 
good...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand. If I feel it's too 
much, I will stop.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Getting shaken by the win rate of the 
Genesis Method just shows my lack of 
confidence..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If only I could build up the strength to 
truly believe that I can win...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She has low self-esteem. If training can 
build up her confidence, that's one way to 
go about it, but..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Besides... all the Umamusume who made 
history possessed a truly dignified and 
majestic presence.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I also believe that those who lack 
confidence in their own legs cannot 
shoulder history...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overdoing training carries risks. But that 
is simply a matter for me to keep under 
control.
choice_data_list: Let's take proper breaks as we go along.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you so much, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So she can leave the hoofprints she 
desires. I'll support her all the way to 
the next race, the Oaks—"
